02Delivery method

A proven path from plan to production.

Our proven SAP implementation methodology runs in five phases, each with clear deliverables and sign-offs, governed with Solution Manager.

  1. 01 Phase one

    Prepare

    Scope, project charter, team and landscape set-up, with Solution Manager in place from day one.

    CharterLandscape
  2. 02 Phase two

    Design

    Fit-to-standard workshops map your processes onto SAP best practice and surface the real gaps.

    WorkshopsBlueprint
  3. 03 Phase three

    Realise

    Configuration, essential enhancements, data migration, and unit and integration testing.

    BuildTest
  4. 04 Phase four

    Deploy

    User-acceptance testing, end-user training and documentation, cut-over and go-live.

    UATGo-live
  5. 05 Phase five

    Maintain

    Hypercare and application support that keep the system healthy and improving.

    SupportOptimise
